final_answer.key_evidence_summary: Alert: POST /api/v1/travelservice/trips/left returned 503 Service Unavailable (entry_service ts-travel-service, 10 occurrences). Object layer was healthy: all train-ticket pods Running 2/2 (only ts-ui-dashboard showed restart noise), and CheckServiceConnectivity to ts-travel-service 10.68.156.18:12346 succeeded from worker-01/02/03; ts-travel-service error log only shows business-level 'Trip already exists'. The break is at the address layer: in ts-gateway-service's own ConfigMap route table, the route id 'travel' declares Path=/api/v1/travelservice/** but targets uri: lb://ts-nonexistent-travel-backend (no such Service exists), while every other route (e.g. travel2 -> lb://${TRAVEL2_SERVICE_HOST:ts-travel2-service}) uses the correct backend. Requests to /api/v1/travelservice/** are therefore load-balanced to a non-existent backend and the gateway answers 503. Namespace events contain no FailedCreate/FailedScheduling/FailedMount/image-pull warnings, excluding quota, scheduling, image and volume causes; the gateway Service declares port 18888 matching server.port 18888, excluding port mapping. Mechanism owner (route-table owner) = ts-gateway-service; mis-wired target victim = ts-travel-service.

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-gateway-service
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: ts-gateway-service
  replicas: 1
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: ts-gateway-service
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: ts-gateway-service
        image: ghcr.io/sregym/ts-gateway-service:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        env:
        - name: SPRING_MAIN_ALLOW_CIRCULAR_REFERENCES
          value: 'true'
        - name: NODE_IP
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: status.hostIP
        envFrom:
        - configMapRef:
            name: nacos
        volumeMounts:
        - name: ts-gateway-service-config
          mountPath: /config/application.yml
          subPath: application.yml
        ports:
        - containerPort: 18888
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 350Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 512Mi
        readinessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 18888
          initialDelaySeconds: 60
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 5
      volumes:
      - name: ts-gateway-service-config
        configMap:
          name: ts-gateway-service-config
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-gateway-service
spec:
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 18888
    nodePort: 30467
  selector:
    app: ts-gateway-service
  type: NodePort
